data.name: Haramoon
data.gender_notes: Haramoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'haram', meaning 'forbidden' or 'sacred', and the suffix 'oon', meaning 'gift' or 'blessing'. The name Haramoon signifies a gift or blessing from God, something that is forbidden or sacred yet a source of joy and happiness. The name Haramoon carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Haramoon usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the divine gift of life and the blessings that come from the Creator.
data.etymology: Haramoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haramoon total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
